title: Lulu's Beef & Broccoli Fried Rice
ingredients: Beef & Marinade: 500g lean steak, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp dark soy, 1 tsp baking soda, 2 tsp cornstarch
Sauce: 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tbsp coconut sugar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 0.5 tsp Chinese 5 spice, 0.5 tsp white pepper, 2 tbsp water
Base: 0.5 tbsp oil, 4 cups cooked day-old jasmine rice
Veggies: 4 cups broccoli florets, 5 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp ginger paste, 3 sliced spring onions
Toppings: 4 fried eggs, chilli oil, sesame seeds
steps: Combine beef with oyster sauce, dark soy, baking soda, cornstarch, and white pepper, then rest for 15 minutes.
Pour boiling water over broccoli florets, let sit for 2 minutes, and drain thoroughly.
Heat oil in a wok on high heat, stir-fry beef for 2 to 3 minutes until browned, then remove.
Sauté garlic, ginger, and spring onion whites for 1 minute in the wok on high heat.
Add rice, broccoli, and mixed sauce, stir-fry for 2 minutes until hot, coated, and well combined.
Toss beef back in with spring onion greens, heat through, and serve topped with fried eggs and chilli oil.
